metadata.title: Schema & Structured Data for AI Discoverability
metadata.description: Schema.org structured data audit and generation optimized for AI discoverability, detect, validate, and generate JSON-LD markup. (Lite edition for workshop use.)
metadata.author: RAINMOJO SO

configuration.purpose: Audit existing structured data and generate JSON-LD markup optimized for AI discoverability and entity recognition.

workflow.purpose: Structured data is the primary machine-readable signal that tells AI systems what an entity IS, what it does, and how it connects to other entities. A complete entity graph in structured data dramatically increases citation probability across all AI search platforms.

step_1_detection.json_ld: Look for <script type='application/ld+json'> blocks. Parse each as JSON. A page may have multiple blocks.
step_1_detection.microdata: Look for itemscope, itemtype, itemprop attributes. Recommend migration to JSON-LD.
step_1_detection.rdfa: Look for typeof, property, vocab attributes. Recommend migration to JSON-LD.
step_1_detection.priority: JSON-LD is strongly recommended. If only Microdata or RDFa found, flag as high-priority migration.
step_1_detection.note: WebFetch strips head content. Use curl or view-source to read the raw HTML that contains the JSON-LD blocks. ต้องทำขั้นที่ 0 ใน SKILL.md ให้เสร็จก่อนเริ่มขั้นนี้ ห้ามสรุปว่าไม่มี schema จากผล WebFetch อย่างเดียว

step_2_validation: Valid JSON: Check syntax (trailing commas, unquoted keys, malformed strings)
Valid @type: Match against recognized Schema.org types
Required Properties: All required properties for the type present
Recommended Properties: AISO-critical recommended properties present
sameAs Links: Links to other platform presences
Nesting: Properly nested (author inside Article, address inside Organization)
Rendering Method: In server-rendered HTML or injected via JavaScript? JS-injected may face delayed processing.

faq_page.note: Google restricts FAQ rich results to govt/health sites since Aug 2023, but AI platforms still parse FAQPage schema for Q&A extraction.
faq_page.structure: @type FAQPage with mainEntity array of Question schemas with acceptedAnswer

website_searchaction.structure: WebSite with potentialAction SearchAction and urlTemplate

speakable.purpose: Marks sections suitable for voice/AI assistant consumption
speakable.usage: Add to Article/WebPage schema with cssSelector pointing to key content sections

step_4_deprecated_schemas.HowTo: Rich results deprecated Aug 2023, still useful for AI parsing
step_4_deprecated_schemas.FAQPage: Restricted to govt/health Aug 2023, still useful for AI parsing
step_4_deprecated_schemas.VideoObject_contentUrl: Changed 2024, must point to actual video file

step_5_sameas_strategy.description: The single most important structured data property for AISO. Creates the entity graph AI platforms use to verify, trust, and cite sources.
priority_order: App Store / Google Play, app listings
audit_process: Verify Organization/Person schema includes ALL of them
Flag platforms where entity should have presence but does not

always_generate: Organization or Person (depending on entity type)
rules: Use @graph pattern for multiple schemas in one block
Place JSON-LD in <head>, NOT injected via JavaScript

items.present_when: A full Organization or Person block exists with name, url, and logo
The entity schema lists sameAs URLs and each one resolves
Article blocks carry an author object with more than just a name
The correct type for the business exists (LocalBusiness, Product, SoftwareApplication, and so on)
The homepage carries a WebSite block with potentialAction SearchAction
Inner pages carry a BreadcrumbList block
Structured data is delivered as JSON-LD rather than Microdata or RDFa
The JSON-LD appears in the raw HTML source rather than being injected by JavaScript
Article or WebPage schema includes a speakable property
Every block parses as JSON and every @type is a recognized Schema.org type
The entity schema includes knowsAbout with at least three topics
No SpecialAnnouncement, CourseInfo, or other retired types are present
